definition.name: 新增用户自然日次日留存
definition.definition: 新增注册用户第二天回来产生会话的比例。
definition.numerator: D 日注册且 D+1 有至少一次会话的去重 user_id 数
definition.denominator: D 日首次注册去重用户数；为零则不可计算
definition.dimensions: users.registration_os / registration_version / channel 固定注册归属
definition.joins: users.user_id = sessions.user_id；EXISTS 防止多会话重复计数
definition.time: Asia/Shanghai 自然日；注册窗口 [start,end)；D+1 完整结束且 users/sessions 水位齐备；D+2 <= sessions.complete_before
definition.pitfalls: 不是滚动 24 小时；不混入活跃老用户；跨日用总留存/总新增，不平均每日比例

parameters.sql:
WITH reg AS (
  SELECT user_id, CAST(registered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai' AS DATE) AS reg_date
  FROM users
  WHERE CAST(registered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai' AS DATE) >= DATE '2026-01-01'
    AND CAST(registered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai' AS DATE) < DATE '2026-01-08'
),
denom AS (
  SELECT reg_date, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS new_users
  FROM reg
  GROUP BY reg_date
),
retained AS (
  SELECT r.reg_date, COUNT(DISTINCT r.user_id) AS retained_users
  FROM reg r
  WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM sessions s
    WHERE s.user_id = r.user_id
      AND CAST(s.started_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai' AS DATE) = r.reg_date + 1
  )
  GROUP BY r.reg_date
)
SELECT d.reg_date,
       d.new_users,
       COALESCE(r.retained_users, 0) AS retained_users,
       COALESCE(r.retained_users, 0) / NULLIF(d.new_users, 0) AS retention_rate
FROM denom d
LEFT JOIN retained r ON d.reg_date = r.reg_date
ORDER BY d.reg_date;
